title: Maximum total building height
text: C3.2.1 Building height complies with Table 3.2a. Table 3.2a Maximum building heights, maximum total building height: R2-R35 10m; R40-R60 13m. Refer Figure 3.2a for building height and natural ground level measurement guidance. Refer Figure 3.2b for total building height guidance.

replaces.note: R10-R25 category B: wall 7 m, total 8 m (gable, skillion, concealed) or 10 m (hipped, pitched) -> 10 m total, no wall or roof-type split (C4P1-071)
wall height and roof-type metrics deleted
R30-R35 concealed/skillion 8 -> 10 m (C4P1-072); R40 10 -> 13 m (C4P1-073); R50-R60 concealed/skillion 11 -> 13 m (C4P1-074)

verified.note: Values clear. Table 3.2a prints the lower row as 'R2-R35' in an R10-R60 chapter; its note cites '3.9 Solar access for adjoining sites' (element 3.8 here). Table 4A (p7) agrees: 10m R10-R35, 13m R40-R60.

notes: from: ch3 C3.2.1#height. Table 3.2a (p28) prints R2-R35 10 m and R40-R60 13 m; the table is trimmed to R10-R60 and the R80+ and R100-SL rows dropped. Height is the highest point above natural ground level (deemed natural ground level where it varies; Figures 3.2a, 3.2b). The table note still points to '3.9 Solar access for adjoining sites', which is element 3.8 in this chapter. Register rows C4P1-071 to C4P1-074 by band.
